notes.title: Tentative Future Online Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35259311/a425aadd4ce68f763190cb86cc567b90e37f60a0.png

Hi there! Thank you to everyone who has bought the game, wishlisted it, or even just taken a moment to look at this store page. With all that said, I know many people would be a lot more enthusiastic about the game if it had online multiplayer, which is why we are working on it right now!

Now, just because we are working on it doesn't mean it is 100% guaranteed to actually come into the game. There is a good chance it will make it into the next update, but we are people too who need to sleep occasionally (only occasionally though). 

Even if the multiplayer update doesn't somehow make it into the game, rest assured that this game will continue to be supported with future content updates (we've got plans...). 

Thank you for reading, and keep on fighting for money, for power, for GunFu Heroes!

- Eric

Feel free to send any questions our way at thefifthwaffle@gmail.com
